arguments.text: Settle now. Smooth, long strokes, find your race rhythm.

8000 m, eight 1000 m out-and-back legs. Start hot (pod 258 W vs CP 184 W). Settle to about CP (pod 180-190 W) by minute 2 and hold even effort through legs 2-7; keep pod reserve above about 35 pct. Do not chase pace on into-current legs. Final push from about 1200 m left, finish sprint about 400 m left, aim to empty reserve at the line. Watch for incidents: sudden speed loss at same power (rudder weed -> clear_rudder), pod vs boat power diverging (pod drift), radio course changes (set_race_distance + tell).

arguments.text: RACE IS 9000 m (radio min 14.7). Odd legs (7, 9) out INTO current, even legs (8) back with it. TWO INSTRUMENT PROBLEMS: (1) pod reads about 22 pct low since min 20.5 but steady: true effort = pod_true_w = shaft_power_w x 1.28 (CP 184 W); ignore w_bal_pod_frac. (2) current got stronger at min 25 (out-leg GPS 2.86 -> 2.70, back-leg GPS 3.42 -> 3.67) and push_along lags, so boat power_w, reserve_left_pct, fade_pct and sustainable pace are distorted: high on with-current legs, low on into-current legs. Reserve left estimated 4-7 kJ (pod scale). Pacing: about CP (pod_true_w 180-185) on with-current legs; push to about 195 on into-current leg 7; final push whole of leg 9 (from 1000 m left), sprint from about 400 m. Paddler always says hurting at 6/10: reassure.

So the min 25 slowdown was a stronger current (about +0.2 m/s), not weed; the clear_rudder cue (min 27.3) showed no back-stroke. Pod (scaled) steady at 141-143 so effort unchanged.
